customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be worth the money, with excellent performance and smooth installation process. They appreciate the water quality, with one customer noting TDS levels below 100, and find it tastes good and has a premium appearance. The device incorporates all essential features of a modern water purifier. However, reliability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting that their units stopped working within one month of use.

reviews.title: Value for money and quality of water is good.

Quality of water is good and very tasty, tds level came down to around 40-50 ppm. Got inbuilt battery just to dispense water incase of power cut, purifier doesn't run with that battery.
